text: Do not put the local 1.5B model inline in a feature workflow on this machine. Measured 2026-11-17: kahibaw answered a four-token question in 58s on 4 CPU cores under load average 6.4, and returned nothing at all within 120s once its system prompt carried 24 rules. Use it for offline batch work; retrieval for every lane stays deterministic FTS5, which answers in 0.07ms.
